sanskrit: yat tvayā kathitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutaṃ saṃjaya tan mayā kaccid duryodhanaḥ sūta na gato vai yamakṣayam brūhi saṃjaya tattvena punar uktāṃ kathām imām
english: The words you have spoken, Saṃjaya, I have heard; but tell me, charioteer—surely Duryodhana has not gone to the abode of Yama? Speak truly, Saṃjaya, and tell over again this same account.

sanskrit: evam ukto 'bravīt sūto rājānaṃ janamejaya hato vaikartano rājan saha putrair mahārathaiḥ bhrātṛbhiś ca maheṣvāsaiḥ sūtaputrais tanutyajaiḥ
english: Thus addressed, Janamejaya, the charioteer answered the king: Slain is Vaikartana, O king, together with his sons, the mighty warriors, and with his brothers, the great archers, the sons of charioteers who gave up their bodies in battle.

sanskrit: duḥśāsanaś ca nihataḥ pāṇḍavena yaśasvinā pītaṃ ca rudhiraṃ kopād bhīmasenena saṃyuge
english: And Duḥśāsana was slain by the glorious son of Pāṇḍu, and in his wrath Bhīmasena drank his blood upon the field of battle.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca etac chrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ abravīt saṃjayaṃ sūtaṃ śokavyākulacetanaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Hearing this, O great king, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the son of Ambikā, his mind distracted with grief, spoke to Saṃjaya the charioteer.

sanskrit: duṣpraṇītena me tāta manasābhiplutātmanaḥ hataṃ vaikartanaṃ śrutvā śoko marmāṇi kṛntati
english: My son, my soul is overwhelmed by my own ill counsel; hearing that Vaikartana is slain, grief cuts me to the quick.

sanskrit: kṛtāstraparamāḥ śalye duḥkhapāraṃ titīrṣavaḥ kurūṇāṃ sṛñjayānāṃ ca ke nu jīvanti ke mṛtāḥ
english: Among the Kurus and the Sṛñjayas, supreme masters of weapons longing to cross to the further shore of sorrow—who now live, and who are dead?

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca hataḥ śāṃtanavo rājan durādharṣaḥ pratāpavān hatvā pāṇḍavayodhānām arbudaṃ daśabhir dinaiḥ
english: Saṃjaya said: Slain, O king, is the son of Śaṃtanu, the unassailable and majestic one, after he had slain a host of the Pāṇḍava warriors in the space of ten days.

sanskrit: tato droṇo maheṣvāsaḥ pāñcālānāṃ rathavrajān nihatya yudhi durdharṣaḥ paścād rukmaratho hataḥ
english: Then Droṇa, the great archer, hard to overcome in battle, having slain the chariot-ranks of the Pāñcālas, was afterward struck down—he of the golden car.

sanskrit: hataśiṣṭasya bhīṣmeṇa droṇena ca mahātmanā ardhaṃ nihatya sainyasya karṇo vaikartano hataḥ
english: And Karṇa, son of Vikartana, having slain half of the army that remained after the slaughter wrought by Bhīṣma and the great-souled Droṇa, was himself slain.

sanskrit: viviṃśatir mahārāja rājaputro mahābalaḥ ānartayodhāñ śataśo nihatya nihato raṇe
english: Viviṃśati, O great king, the mighty prince, having slain the Ānarta warriors by hundreds, was himself slain in battle.

sanskrit: atha putro vikarṇas te kṣatravratam anusmaran kṣīṇavāhāyudhaḥ śūraḥ sthito 'bhimukhataḥ parān
english: Then your son Vikarṇa, mindful of the kṣatriya's vow, the hero whose mount and weapons were spent, stood facing the foe.

sanskrit: ghorarūpān parikleśān duryodhanakṛtān bahūn pratijñāṃ smaratā caiva bhīmasenena pātitaḥ
english: He was struck down by Bhīmasena, who remembered the many dreadful torments wrought by Duryodhana, and his own oath as well.

sanskrit: vindānuvindāv āvantyau rājaputrau mahābalau kṛtvā nasukaraṃ karma gatau vaivasvatakṣayam
english: Vinda and Anuvinda, the two princes of Avanti, mighty in strength, having performed a deed no easy thing to do, went to the abode of the son of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: sindhurāṣṭramukhānīha daśa rāṣṭrāṇi yasya vai vaśe tiṣṭhanti vīrasya yaḥ sthitas tava śāsane
english: That hero under whose sway ten realms, the kingdom of Sindhu chief among them, abode, and who stood firm in your command—

sanskrit: akṣauhiṇīr daśaikāṃ ca nirjitya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ arjunena hato rājan mahāvīryo jayadrathaḥ
english: that Jayadratha of great valor, having vanquished eleven divisions of troops with his sharpened arrows, was slain by Arjuna, O king.

sanskrit: tathā duryodhanasutas tarasvī yuddhadurmadaḥ vartamānaḥ pituḥ śāstre saubhadreṇa nipātitaḥ
english: So too the swift son of Duryodhana, frenzied for battle, abiding by his father's command, was struck down by the son of Subhadrā.

sanskrit: tathā dauḥśāsanir vīro bāhuśālī raṇotkaṭaḥ draupadeyena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: So too the heroic son of Duḥśāsana, strong of arm and fierce in battle, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by the son of Draupadī.

sanskrit: kirātānām adhipatiḥ sāgarānūpavāsinām devarājasya dharmātmā priyo bahumataḥ sakhā
english: The lord of the Kirātas who dwell along the sea-marshes, righteous of soul, the dear and highly esteemed friend of the king of the gods—

sanskrit: bhagadatto mahīpālaḥ kṣatradharmarataḥ sadā dhanaṃjayena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: that king Bhagadatta, ever devoted to the kṣatriya's law, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by Dhanaṃjaya.

sanskrit: tathā kauravadāyādaḥ saumadattir mahāyaśāḥ hato bhūriśravā rājañ śūraḥ sātyakinā yudhi
english: So too the heir of the Kurus, the son of Somadatta, of great renown, the hero Bhūriśravas, was slain in battle by Sātyaki, O king.

sanskrit: śrutāyur api cāmbaṣṭhaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ dhanurdharaḥ carann abhītavat saṃkhye nihataḥ savyasācinā
english: And Śrutāyu of the Ambaṣṭhas, a bowman among kṣatriyas, ranging fearlessly through the fray, was slain by Savyasācin.

sanskrit: tava putraḥ sadā saṃkhye kṛtāstro yuddhadurmadaḥ duḥśāsano mahārāja bhīmasenena pātitaḥ
english: Your son Duḥśāsana, ever skilled in arms in battle and frenzied for the fight, was struck down by Bhīmasena, O great king.

sanskrit: yasya rājan gajānīkaṃ bahusāhasram adbhutam sudakṣiṇaḥ sa saṃgrāme nihataḥ savyasācinā
english: That Sudakṣiṇa, O king, whose elephant host was many thousands strong and wondrous, was slain in the encounter by Savyasācin.

sanskrit: kosalānām adhipatir hatvā bahuśatān parān saubhadreṇa hi vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: The lord of the Kosalas, having slain his foes by the hundreds, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by the son of Subhadrā.

sanskrit: bahuśo yodhayitvā ca bhīmasenaṃ mahārathaḥ citrasenas tava suto bhīmasenena pātitaḥ
english: Your son Citrasena, a great chariot-warrior, having fought many a bout with Bhīmasena, was struck down by Bhīmasena himself.

sanskrit: madrarājātmajaḥ śūraḥ pareṣāṃ bhayavardhanaḥ asicarmadharaḥ śrīmān saubhadreṇa nipātitaḥ
english: The heroic son of the king of the Madras, who heightened the terror of his foes, the resplendent bearer of sword and shield, was struck down by the son of Subhadrā.

sanskrit: samaḥ karṇasya samare yaḥ sa karṇasya paśyataḥ vṛṣaseno mahātejāḥ śīghrāstraḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ
english: Vṛṣasena, of great splendor, swift with his weapons and firm of resolve, the equal of Karṇa in battle, before the very eyes of Karṇa—

sanskrit: abhimanyor vadhaṃ smṛtvā pratijñām api cātmanaḥ dhanaṃjayena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: recalling the slaying of Abhimanyu and his own vow as well, Dhanaṃjaya sent him valorously to the seat of Yama.

sanskrit: nityaprasaktavairo yaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ viśrāvya vairaṃ pārthena śrutāyuḥ sa nipātitaḥ
english: That lord of earth Śrutāyu, ever bound in unceasing enmity with the Pāṇḍavas, having proclaimed his feud, was struck down by Pārtha.

sanskrit: śalyaputras tu vikrāntaḥ sahadevena māriṣa hato rukmaratho rājan bhrātā mātulajo yudhi
english: And the valiant son of Śalya, Rukmaratha, your nephew on the mother's side, O honored one, was slain in battle by Sahadeva, O king.

sanskrit: rājā bhagīratho vṛddho bṛhatkṣatraś ca kekayaḥ parākramantau vikrāntau nihatau vīryavattarau
english: The aged king Bhagīratha and Bṛhatkṣatra of the Kekayas, two valiant ones of surpassing might, striving in their prowess, were slain.

sanskrit: bhagadattasuto rājan kṛtaprajño mahābalaḥ śyenavac caratā saṃkhye nakulena nipātitaḥ
english: The son of Bhagadatta, O king, sagacious and mighty in strength, was struck down by Nakula, who ranged through the battle like a hawk.

sanskrit: pitāmahas tava tathā bāhlikaḥ saha bāhlikaiḥ bhīmasenena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: Your grandsire too, Bāhlika, together with the Bāhlīkas, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by Bhīmasena.

sanskrit: jayatsenas tathā rājañ jārāsaṃdhir mahābalaḥ māgadho nihataḥ saṃkhye saubhadreṇa mahātmanā
english: So too Jayatsena, son of Jarāsaṃdha, of great strength, the Māgadha, was slain in battle by the great-souled son of Subhadrā.

sanskrit: putras te durmukho rājan duḥsahaś ca mahārathaḥ gadayā bhīmasenena nihatau śūramāninau
english: Your sons Durmukha and Duḥsaha, the great chariot-warrior, O king, who held themselves heroes, were both slain by Bhīmasena with his mace.

sanskrit: durmarṣaṇo durviṣaho durjayaś ca mahārathaḥ kṛtvā nasukaraṃ karma gatā vaivasvatakṣayam
english: Durmarṣaṇa, Durviṣaha, and Durjaya the great chariot-warrior, having performed a deed no easy thing to do, went to the abode of the son of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: sacivo vṛṣavarmā te sūtaḥ paramavīryavān bhīmasenena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: Your counselor Vṛṣavarman, the charioteer of supreme valor, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by Bhīmasena.

sanskrit: nāgāyutabalo rājā nāgāyutabalo mahān sagaṇaḥ pāṇḍuputreṇa nihataḥ savyasācinā
english: The king Nāgāyutabala, mighty with the strength of ten thousand elephants, together with his troop, was slain by the son of Pāṇḍu, Savyasācin.

sanskrit: vasātayo mahārāja dvisāhasrāḥ prahāriṇaḥ śūrasenāś ca vikrāntāḥ sarve yudhi nipātitāḥ
english: The Vasātis, O great king, two thousand fighting men, and the valiant Śūrasenas, were all struck down in battle.

sanskrit: abhīṣāhāḥ kavacinaḥ praharanto madotkaṭāḥ śibayaś ca rathodārāḥ kaliṅgasahitā hatāḥ
english: The mailed Abhīṣāhas, smiting and frenzied with battle-fury, and the noble car-warriors among the Śibis, together with the Kaliṅgas, were slain.

sanskrit: gokule nityasaṃvṛddhā yuddhe paramakovidāḥ śreṇayo bahusāhasrāḥ saṃśaptakagaṇāś ca ye te sarve pārtham āsādya gatā vaivasvatakṣayam
english: The bands reared ever among the cow-herds, supremely skilled in war, the troops many thousands strong, and the hosts of the saṃśaptakas—all these, having come against Pārtha, went to the abode of the son of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: syālau tava mahārāja rājānau vṛṣakācalau tvadarthe saṃparākrāntau nihatau savyasācinā
english: Your two brothers-in-law, O great king, the kings Vṛṣaka and Acala, who strove valiantly for your sake, were slain by Savyasācin.

sanskrit: ugrakarmā maheṣvāso nāmataḥ karmatas tathā śālvarājo mahārāja bhīmasenena pātitaḥ
english: The king of the Śālvas, a great archer fierce in deed both in name and in act, O great king, was struck down by Bhīmasena.

sanskrit: oghavāṃś ca mahārāja bṛhantaḥ sahito raṇe parākramantau mitrārthe gatau vaivasvatakṣayam
english: Oghavat and Bṛhanta together, O great king, striving in battle for their ally's sake, went to the abode of the son of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: tathaiva rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣemadhūrtir viśāṃ pate nihato gadayā rājan bhīmasenena saṃyuge
english: So too the foremost of car-warriors, Kṣemadhūrti, O lord of peoples, was slain with the mace by Bhīmasena in the fray, O king.

sanskrit: tathā rājā maheṣvāso jalasaṃdho mahābalaḥ sumahat kadanaṃ kṛtvā hataḥ sātyakinā raṇe
english: So too the king Jalasaṃdha, a great archer of mighty strength, having wrought a vast slaughter, was slain by Sātyaki in battle.

sanskrit: alāyudho rākṣasendraḥ kharabandhurayānagaḥ ghaṭotkacena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: Alāyudha, lord of the rākṣasas, who rode a car drawn by asses, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by Ghaṭotkaca.

sanskrit: rādheyāḥ sūtaputrāś ca bhrātaraś ca mahārathāḥ kekayāḥ sarvaśaś cāpi nihatāḥ savyasācinā
english: The sons of Rādhā and the charioteers' sons, and his brothers the great car-warriors, and the Kekayas as well, were all slain by Savyasācin.

sanskrit: mālavā madrakāś caiva draviḍāś cogravikramāḥ yaudheyāś ca lalitthāś ca kṣudrakāś cāpy uśīnarāḥ
english: The Mālavas and the Madrakas, the Draviḍas of fierce prowess, the Yaudheyas and the Lalitthas, the Kṣudrakas and the Uśīnaras—

sanskrit: māvellakās tuṇḍikerāḥ sāvitrīputrakāñcalāḥ prācyodīcyāḥ pratīcyāś ca dākṣiṇātyāś ca māriṣa
english: the Māvellakas, the Tuṇḍikeras, the Sāvitrīputras and the Kāñcalas, the men of the East and the North, of the West and of the South, O honored one—

sanskrit: pattīnāṃ nihatāḥ saṃghā hayānām ayutāni ca rathavrajāś ca nihatā hatāś ca varavāraṇāḥ
english: the throngs of footmen were slain, and tens of thousands of horses, and the ranks of chariots were destroyed, and the noble elephants slain.

sanskrit: sadhvajāḥ sāyudhāḥ śūrāḥ savarmāmbarabhūṣaṇāḥ kālena mahatā yattāḥ kule ye ca vivardhitāḥ
english: Heroes with their banners, their weapons, their armor, raiment, and ornaments, prepared over a long span of time and reared each in his own line—

sanskrit: te hatāḥ samare rājan pārthenākliṣṭakarmaṇā anye tathāmitabalāḥ parasparavadhaiṣiṇaḥ
english: these were slain in battle, O king, by Pārtha of untiring deeds, and others of measureless strength who sought one another's destruction.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo rājānaḥ sagaṇā raṇe hatāḥ sahasraśo rājan yan māṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi evam eṣa kṣayo vṛttaḥ karṇārjunasamāgame
english: These and many other kings with their hosts were slain by the thousands in battle, O king, as you ask of me; thus came about this destruction at the meeting of Karṇa and Arjuna.

sanskrit: mahendreṇa yathā vṛtro yathā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ yathā kṛṣṇena nihato muro raṇanipātitaḥ kārtavīryaś ca rāmeṇa bhārgaveṇa hato yathā
english: As Vṛtra was slain by great Indra, as Rāvaṇa by Rāma, as Muru was cast down and slain in battle by Kṛṣṇa, and as Kārtavīrya was slain by Rāma of the Bhṛgu line—

sanskrit: sajñātibāndhavaḥ śūraḥ samare yuddhadurmadaḥ raṇe kṛtvā mahāyuddhaṃ ghoraṃ trailokyaviśrutam
english: so the hero with his kinsmen and friends, frenzied for the fight in battle, having waged a great and terrible war renowned through the three worlds—

sanskrit: tathārjunena nihato dvairathe yuddhadurmadaḥ sāmātyabāndhavo rājan karṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
english: even so Karṇa, the best of smiters, frenzied for the fight, was slain in single chariot-combat by Arjuna, together with his counselors and kinsmen, O king.

sanskrit: jayāśā dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ vairasya ca mukhaṃ yataḥ tīrṇaṃ tat pāṇḍavai rājan yat purā nāvabudhyase
english: The hope of victory of the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and the very source of the feud, that have the Pāṇḍavas now passed beyond, O king—that which long ago you would not perceive.

sanskrit: ucyamāno mahārāja bandhubhir hitakāṅkṣibhiḥ tad idaṃ samanuprāptaṃ vyasanaṃ tvāṃ mahātyayam
english: Though told of it, O great king, by kinsmen who wished you well, this calamity of great ruin has now overtaken you.

sanskrit: putrāṇāṃ rājyakāmānāṃ tvayā rājan hitaiṣiṇā ahitānīva cīrṇāni teṣāṃ te phalam āgatam
english: Wishing well to your sons who craved a kingdom, O king, you wrought what was as if to their harm; the fruit of those deeds has now come upon you.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca ākhyātā māmakās tāta nihatā yudhi pāṇḍavaiḥ nihatān pāṇḍaveyānāṃ māmakair brūhi saṃjaya
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: You have told me, my son, of my own men slain in battle by the Pāṇḍavas; now tell me, Saṃjaya, of the Pāṇḍavas' men slain by mine.

sanskrit: saṃjaya uvāca kuntayo yudhi vikrāntā mahāsattvā mahābalāḥ sānubandhāḥ sahāmātyā bhīṣmeṇa yudhi pātitāḥ
english: Saṃjaya said: The Kuntis, valiant in battle, of great courage and great strength, with their followers and counselors, were struck down in battle by Bhīṣma.

sanskrit: samaḥ kirīṭinā saṃkhye vīryeṇa ca balena ca satyajit satyasaṃdhena droṇena nihato raṇe
english: Satyajit, the equal in battle of the diademed one in valor and in strength, was slain in the fray by the true-vowed Droṇa.

sanskrit: tathā virāṭadrupadau vṛddhau sahasutau nṛpau parākramantau mitrārthe droṇena nihatau raṇe
english: So too the aged kings Virāṭa and Drupada, together with their sons, striving for their ally's sake, were slain in battle by Droṇa.

sanskrit: yo bāla eva samare saṃmitaḥ savyasācinā keśavena ca durdharṣo baladevena cābhibhūḥ
english: He who, though but a boy in battle, was reckoned the equal of Savyasācin, of Keśava, and of Baladeva, unassailable and overpowering—

sanskrit: sa eṣa kadanaṃ kṛtvā mahad raṇaviśāradaḥ parivārya mahāmātraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paramakai rathaiḥ aśaknuvadbhir bībhatsum abhimanyur nipātitaḥ
english: that very Abhimanyu, skilled in war, having wrought a great slaughter, was surrounded by six foremost mighty chariot-warriors who could not withstand Bībhatsu, and was struck down.

sanskrit: taṃ kṛtaṃ virathaṃ vīraṃ kṣatradharme vyavasthitam dauḥśāsanir mahārāja saubhadraṃ hatavān raṇe
english: That hero, made carless yet steadfast in the kṣatriya's law, the son of Subhadrā, was slain in battle by the son of Duḥśāsana, O great king.

sanskrit: bṛhantas tu maheṣvāsaḥ kṛtāstro yuddhadurmadaḥ duḥśāsanena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: Bṛhanta, the great archer skilled in arms and frenzied for the fight, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by Duḥśāsana.

sanskrit: maṇimān daṇḍadhāraś ca rājānau yuddhadurmadau parākramantau mitrārthe droṇena vinipātitau
english: Maṇimat and Daṇḍadhāra, two kings frenzied for the fight, striving for their ally's sake, were struck down by Droṇa.

sanskrit: aṃśumān bhojarājas tu sahasainyo mahārathaḥ bhāradvājena vikramya gamito yamasādanam
english: Aṃśumat, the Bhoja king, a great chariot-warrior, together with his army, was sent valorously to the seat of Yama by the son of Bharadvāja.

sanskrit: citrāyudhaś citrayodhī kṛtvā tau kadanaṃ mahat citramārgeṇa vikramya karṇena nihatau yudhi
english: Citrāyudha and Citrayodhin, having both wrought a great slaughter, were slain in battle by Karṇa, who struck them valorously by a wondrous course of arms.

sanskrit: vṛkodarasamo yuddhe dṛḍhaḥ kekayajo yudhi kekayenaiva vikramya bhrātrā bhrātā nipātitaḥ
english: The Kekaya prince, the equal of Vṛkodara in battle and steadfast in the fray, was struck down valorously by his own brother, a Kekaya—brother by brother.

sanskrit: janamejayo gadāyodhī pārvatīyaḥ pratāpavān durmukhena mahārāja tava putreṇa pātitaḥ
english: Janamejaya, the mace-fighter of the mountain-folk, full of majesty, was struck down by your son Durmukha, O great king.

sanskrit: rocamānau naravyāghrau rocamānau grahāv iva droṇena yugapad rājan divaṃ saṃpreṣitau śaraiḥ
english: The two Rocamānas, tigers among men, shining like two planets, were sent at once to heaven by Droṇa's arrows, O king.

sanskrit: nṛpāś ca pratiyudhyantaḥ parākrāntā viśāṃ pate kṛtvā nasukaraṃ karma gatā vaivasvatakṣayam
english: And kings who fought back valiantly, O lord of peoples, having performed a deed no easy thing to do, went to the abode of the son of Vivasvat.

sanskrit: purujit kuntibhojaś ca mātulaḥ savyasācinaḥ saṃgrāmanirjitāṃl lokān gamito droṇasāyakaiḥ
english: Purujit Kuntibhoja, the maternal uncle of Savyasācin, was sent by Droṇa's shafts to the worlds won by battle.

sanskrit: abhibhūḥ kāśirājaś ca kāśikair bahubhir vṛtaḥ vasudānasya putreṇa nyāsito deham āhave
english: Abhibhū, the king of Kāśi, surrounded by many men of Kāśi, was made to lay down his body in the fight by the son of Vasudāna.

sanskrit: amitaujā yudhāmanyur uttamaujāś ca vīryavān nihatya śataśaḥ śūrān parair vinihatau raṇe
english: Yudhāmanyu of measureless might and the valiant Uttamaujas, having slain heroes by the hundreds, were slain by the foe in battle.

sanskrit: kṣatradharmā ca pāñcālyaḥ kṣatravarmā ca māriṣa droṇena parameṣvāsau gamitau yamasādanam
english: Kṣatradharman the Pāñcāla and Kṣatravarman, O honored one, those two supreme archers, were sent to the seat of Yama by Droṇa.

sanskrit: śikhaṇḍitanayo yuddhe kṣatradevo yudhāṃ patiḥ lakṣmaṇena hato rājaṃs tava pautreṇa bhārata
english: The son of Śikhaṇḍin, Kṣatradeva, a lord of warriors, was slain in battle by Lakṣmaṇa, your grandson, O king, O descendant of Bharata.
